bio.zh: 研究随机系统的自适应辨识与控制，关注分布式学习、稀疏辨识及其数学基础。2026 年 6 月加入复旦大学数学科学学院，此前任南开大学人工智能学院副教授。
bio.en: My research focuses on adaptive identification and control of stochastic systems, with interests in distributed learning, sparse identification and their mathematical foundations. I joined Fudan University in June 2026, after serving as an Associate Professor at Nankai University.

zh: 分布式自适应学习与控制
研究多个节点如何利用各自的数据协同学习、估计并控制随机系统。
en: How networked agents learn, estimate and control stochastic systems using local data.

zh: 随机动态系统的稀疏辨识
关注如何从带噪观测中识别系统的关键参数与稀疏结构。
en: Identifying essential parameters and sparse structures in stochastic dynamical systems from noisy observations.

zh: 关注分布式数据学习与基于反馈的决策方法。
en: Learning from distributed data and studying feedback-driven decision methods.

zh: 数学与人工智能的交叉
探索学习与估计问题背后的数学理论。
en: Exploring the mathematical foundations of learning and estimation.

intro.zh: 希望将随机系统辨识与自适应估计的研究拓展到灵巧手，探索从关节运动与接触反馈中建立、更新系统模型的方法。
intro.en: I am interested in extending stochastic system identification and adaptive estimation to dexterous hands, exploring how joint motion and contact feedback can inform models that evolve with the system.

zh: 如何辨识摩擦、耦合与驱动特性，建立适于在线估计的模型？
en: How can friction, coupling and actuator properties be identified in a model suitable for online estimation?

zh: 在接触条件变化、观测含噪时，如何估计关键参数并刻画不确定性？
en: How can key parameters and uncertainty be estimated under changing contact conditions and noisy observations?

zh: 如何将在线更新的模型用于控制，并分析闭环中的估计与稳定性？
en: How can online model updates inform control, with analysis of estimation and stability in closed loop?
